_meta.name: Documentation-assist map (note ↔ code linkage)
_meta.purpose: For each code: what the note must contain to support it. This is pillar 3 of the provider app — the piece Codify/Encoda don't do well.
_meta.source: Office/outpatient E/M selectors paraphrased from published 2021+ AMA E/M guidance (total time on the encounter date, or MDM 2-of-3). Time ranges and MDM levels are objective, published guidance — NOT AMA-licensed long descriptions.
_meta.action_required: VALIDATE every entry against BHW's own Coders' Specialty Guide / Documentation Guide before relying on it clinically. This seed covers only the office E/M family + AWV. Extend it (per the brief) to the highest-volume codes next: behavioral (90837/90834/99484), CCM (99490/99484/G0557), cognitive (99483), Flow (93923/93923-family).
_meta.em_thresholds: minMinutes = the lower bound of that code's published total-time range; mdm = the minimum MDM level that supports the code (2 of 3 elements).
